name: print-social-orange-car-protection-social-set
title: Six orange and white car-protection posts with photos, a rising arrow chart and abstract shapes
whatItIs: A 3x2 grid of posts in saturated orange with white and grey: a car with a rising line chart, cropped car-damage photos in rounded tiles, a smiling woman in a car, a professional in an abstract asterisk shape, a family in an orange cutout, and an orange car on white with grey geometric shapes.
whatItMeans: Trustworthy and warm; orange gives energy to an insurance product.
techniques: Fill posts with one orange and photos.

vocabulary.definition: A photo cropped with rounded corners.
A rising line with an arrowhead.
